items.markdown:
![Cheow Lan Lake with children - the highlight of Khao Sok](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270929-1672-0139-0000-3e534cefde45:8)
Cheow Lan Lake is a stunning 185-square-kilometre artificial reservoir located inside [Khao Sok National Park](https://www.thainationalparks.com/khao-sok-national-park) in Surat Thani Province, Thailand . Famous for its emerald-green waters, towering limestone karsts, and floating raft houses, it was created in 1987 by the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) following the construction of the Ratchaprapha Dam.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cheow_Lan_Lake) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cheow_Lan_Lake)[[2]](https://www.khaosok.com/cheow-larn-lake/)[[3]](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/cheow-lan-lake-information-guide/)

Key Highlights & Activities

- **Scenery & Landmarks:** Over 100 steep limestone outcrops rise from the water, most notably the iconic *Khao Sam Kloe* (three finger-like rock pillars).[](https://www.thainationalparks.com/cheow-lan-lake) [[1]](https://www.thainationalparks.com/cheow-lan-lake)[[2]](https://www.khaosokecoresort.com/activities/cheow-lan-lake-khao-sok-full-day-tour/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Don6u1efpqg&vl=en&t=1)[[4]](http://www.focrates.com/articles/thailandvietnam_2024/thailandvietnam_2024_part4.html)
- **Floating Bungalows:** Overnight stays in rustic or upgraded floating raft houses operated on the water.[](https://www.khaosokaccommodation.com/khao-sok-news/cheow-lan-lake-utimate-travel-guide) [[1]](https://www.khaosokaccommodation.com/khao-sok-news/cheow-lan-lake-utimate-travel-guide)
- **Exploration & Adventure:** Long-tail boat cruising, kayaking, swimming in designated zones, and trekking through hidden caves like *Coral Cave* or *Nam Talu Cave*.[](https://www.khaosokaccommodation.com/khao-sok-news/cheow-lan-lake-utimate-travel-guide) [[1]](https://khaosoklake.com/khao-sok-national-park-cheow-lan-lake)
- **Wildlife:** Opportunities to spot long-tailed macaques, gibbons, hornbills, and occasionally elephants along the edges of the surrounding ancient rainforest.[](https://www.khaosokaccommodation.com/khao-sok-news/cheow-lan-lake-utimate-travel-guide) 

Getting There & Visiting Tips

- **Travel Times:** Access is via the [Cheow Lan Pier (Ratchaprapha Pier)](https://www.thainationalparks.com/cheow-lan-lake) , located roughly 1.5 hours by road from Khao Sok village, 1.5 hours from Surat Thani Airport, and 2.5 to 3 hours from Phuket.[](https://www.thainationalparks.com/cheow-lan-lake) [[1]](https://www.cheowlanlaketravel.com/cheowlarnlake)
- **Fees:** Entering the national park requires a 300 Baht per person entry fee.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Don6u1efpqg&vl=en&t=1) 
- **Duration:** Day trips are widely available, but spending 1 to 2 nights on the water provides the best weather and wildlife viewing experience at dawn and dusk.[](https://www.khao-sok-riverside-cottages.com/cheow-lan-lake-information-guide/) 

If you are planning a trip, let me know:

- **Where are you traveling from** (Phuket, Krabi, Surat Thani, etc.)?
- Are you looking for a **day trip** or an **overnight stay** in a floating bungalow?

 I had a really good day on Cheow Lan Lake and the scenery is honestly hard to beat. The limestone cliffs rising out of the green water looked almost unreal, and the boat ride was the best part for me — quiet in spots except for the engine and the slap of water on the sides.
